name: @rezapace/xpath-pom
description: Chrome MV3 extension that inspects page elements and generates XPath, CSS, Playwright and Katalon locators, plus a Generate POM workflow for Katalon/Groovy page objects.
author: Reza Hidayat <97022190+rezapace@users.noreply.github.com> (https://github.com/rezapace)

scripts.test: node tests/katalon.cjs && node tests/pom.cjs && node tests/runtime-invalidation.cjs
scripts.lint:manifest: node -e "const m=require('./manifest.json'); if(m.manifest_version!==3) throw new Error('manifest_version must be 3'); if(m.version!==require('./package.json').version) throw new Error('manifest.json and package.json versions differ'); console.log('manifest ok:', m.name, m.version)"
